sections.h2: Most factory plans filed with DPIIT never appear as started production

chart.title: Only 15% of 2001–2018 filings are cited by a later production report
chart.sub: Share of 48,485 Part A memoranda filed 2001–2018, %.
chart.source: DPIIT monthly IEM lists, parsed by this blog.
rows: Part B cites the Part A number

sections.means: Filing a plan with DPIIT is not a commitment to build, so most filings leave no production record.
sections.todo: DPIIT should give every Part A filing a status such as production started, still planned, withdrawn or lapsed.

sections.h2: Filings from later years were more likely to be followed by production

chart.title: Share of filings reaching production rose from 19% to 36% across the period
chart.sub: Share of Part A filings that reached Part B, counting name-only matches, %.
chart.source: DPIIT monthly IEM lists, parsed by this blog.
rows: later years have less time to report

sections.means: Later filings show a higher share, but filings from 2020 onwards are understated because the Part B lists stop in August 2024.
sections.todo: DPIIT should resume the monthly IEM Statistics Report so the series from 2001 is not broken by the move to NSWS.

sections.h2: Plants proposed in Assam were followed through far more often than in Tamil Nadu

chart.title: Assam reached production at 45% of filings, Tamil Nadu at 12%
chart.sub: Share of 2001–2018 Part A filings that reached Part B, by plant state, %.
chart.source: DPIIT monthly IEM lists, parsed by this blog.

sections.means: The share that reached production varies widely by the state where the plant was proposed.
sections.todo: MoSPI should link IEM acknowledgement numbers to the Annual Survey of Industries through GSTIN or CIN, so production can be checked from survey and tax records.
